```{r}
library(caTools)
library(plsRcox)
library(dplyr)
library(caret)
```

```{r}
### OUS 
# Inner join between table1 and table2
ous <- merge(OUS_D3, response_ous, by="patient_id", all=FALSE)

# Drop patient_id column 
ous <- ous[, -which(names(ous) == "patient_id")]

# Drop other columns 
ous <- ous %>%
  select(-LRC, -OS, -event_LRC, -event_OS)
```
 
```{r}
### MAASTRO 
# Inner join between table1 and table2
maastro <- merge(MAASTRO_D3, maastro_response_full, by="patient_id", all=FALSE)

# Drop patient_id column 
maastro <- maastro[, -which(names(maastro) == "patient_id")]

# Drop other columns 
maastro <- maastro %>%
  select(-LRC, -OS, -LRC_event, -OS_event)
```

```{r}
X <- ous[, !names(ous) %in% c("DFS", "event_DFS")]
y <- ous[, c("DFS", "event_DFS")]
```

```{r}
# Initialize a list to store the results
set.seed(123)
results_list <- vector("list", length = 20)  

# Repeat the process 20 times
for (i in 1:20) {
  # Create train and test indices
  trainIndex <- createDataPartition(ous$event_DFS, p = 0.8, list = FALSE, times = 1)
  X_train <- X[trainIndex, ]
  
  excluded_columns <- c('female', 
                        'cavum_oris',
                        'oropharynx',
                        'hypopharynx',
                        'larynx',
                        'histgrade_high',
                        'hpv_related',
                        'charlson',
                        'uicc8_III-IV') 
  
  # Min-Max scaling for columns except those in excluded_columns
  min_max_scaled_data <- apply(X_train[, !names(X_train) %in% excluded_columns], 2, function(x) {
    (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x))
  })
  
  # Combine Min-Max scaled and non-scaled columns
  X_train_scaled <- cbind(X_train[, excluded_columns], min_max_scaled_data)
  
  # Define the PLSR model with nt components
  result <- plsRcox(X_train_scaled, time = y$DFS[trainIndex], event = y$event_DFS[trainIndex], nt = 10)
  
  coefficients_df <- as.data.frame(result$Coeffs)
  
  # Add feature names as a new column
  coefficients_df$feature <- rownames(coefficients_df)
  
  # Add an additional column for absolute values of coefficients
  coefficients_df$absolute_value <- abs(coefficients_df$`V1`)
  
  # Sort the data frame based on the absolute values of the coefficients
  sorted_coefficients_df <- coefficients_df[order(-coefficients_df$absolute_value), ]
  
  # Store the sorted coefficients dataframe in the results list
  results_list[[i]] <- sorted_coefficients_df
}
```

```{r}
# Combine results_list into a single dataframe
features_df <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Calculate the sum of V1 for each feature
sums_df <- features_df %>%
  group_by(feature) %>%
  summarise(absolute_value = sum(absolute_value)) %>%
  arrange(desc(absolute_value))

# Reorder levels of the factor variable
sums_df$feature <- factor(sums_df$feature, levels = sums_df$feature[order(sums_df$absolute_value, decreasing = TRUE)])
```

```{r fig.align="center", echo = FALSE,fig.width = 80,fig.height = 20}
ggplot(sums_df) +  
  geom_bar(aes(x = feature, y = absolute_value),
           stat = "identity", 
           width = 0.8,
           fill = "skyblue") +
  geom_line(aes(x = feature, y = absolute_value, group = 1), 
            stat = "identity", 
            color = "blue",
            size = 7) + 
  geom_point(aes(x = feature, y = absolute_value),  
             color = "red",
             size = 3.5) +
  labs(x = "Feature",
       y = "Sum of Absolute Importance Values", 
       title = "Feature Importance using Cox PLSR") +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust=0, size=15),
        axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 180, hjust = 1, size=15),
        axis.title.x = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size=45),
        axis.title.y = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, size=45),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size=60)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 8.5, color = "red", linetype = "solid", size=3.5)  # Add a vertical line
```
